https://github.com/ubiquity-os-marketplace/text-conversation-rewards/actions/runs/11391111007/job/31694182036#step:3:29 my suspicion is that the `endpoint: ''` is the problem, I'll check.

Indeed the configuration gave an empty string for the endpoint, I fixed it here but we might want to fix it everywhere.
Somehow I got excluded from the results (my permit got properly generated) and the URL displays at the bottom. I did not do such changes, need to investigate.
@whck6 Sorry about that, we are experiencing some issues with our RPCs and are actively trying to solve this.

You should fix the tests within
tests/configuration.test.ts [[link](https://github.com/ubiquity-os-marketplace/text-conversation-rewards/blob/1409b0dd7a3b15758236668e3670024c0739a935/tests/configuration.test.ts)] since the default configuration has changed. Do not worry about the other ones.
This should not be removed otherwise the configuration will never be used.

You can just add
```typescript
baseURL: this._configuration.openAi.endpoint
```
since the point of that PR is to always populate the URL. You can even enforce a URL pattern in the cofiguration to make sure that it is at least a valid address.
Not sure of what you mean, this is just an example for usage. Since you removed this code it doesn't work anymore, because no value is passed to the constructor of `OpenAi`.

`endpoint` is not referenced anywhere within the code with your change so it is pointless to have it in the configuration. A proper fix would consist in:
- adding a default endpoint value (that part you did)
- removing the condition within the OpenAi constructor (because there is a default)
- add a `pattern` check to make sure that the `endpoint` corresponds to a URL (it's ok if the URL is unreachable, this will stop at runtime)
Thank you. Could you add the url pattern check?
Something basic like `http[s]:\/\/\S+` should suffice.
This is meant to go in the plugin configuration not here.

The configuration should check and display errors in needed:
https://github.com/ubiquity-os-marketplace/text-conversation-rewards/blob/47e7df86d9d6e94e686b4e78912a580c242ae469/src/configuration/content-evaluator-config.ts#L13

```suggestion

```
Please check this regex I am not sure it's quite right, and add a related test.
